seeds.title: Python 3.11 not available locally
seeds.detail: The f-string source-slice rule was run on 3.9, 3.12 and 3.14 only. 3.11 and 3.13 were not run. CI uses 3.x.

seeds.title: Body pin is sensitive to string re-quoting
seeds.detail: Changing a quote style in a wrapper body changes wrapperBodies (TC-contract-27). This is safe but asks a reviewer to update the pin for a style change.
